title: Ath-Thabat al-Akhlaqi fi Zaman al-Fitan (13-15 Years)
description: A path to assist parents in steadfasting their teenager’s akhlaq amidst fitan (trials): ‘iffah (chastity) and the early stages of instinct, companionship in the age of social media, ikhlas (sincerity), and building a conscience that is mindful of Allah.

primary_reference.info: تربية الأولاد في الإسلام لعبد الله ناصح علوان + منهج التربية النبوية للطفل لمحمد نور سويد

review_defects.why: 'Steadfasting' is not a standard English verb; the Arabic 'تثبيت' means 'making firm' or 'strengthening'. The translation uses a non-standard word that may confuse readers.
